tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: credential-navy
tokens.usage: Deep authority, professional trust, institutional stability. Used as text on `.header-title`, `.section-title`, `.credential-title`. 9.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: verification-green
tokens.usage: Verified status, approved credentials, active certifications. Used as text on `.status-badge`, `.credential-badge.verified`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: swiss-black
tokens.usage: Primary text, maximum hierarchy, Swiss precision. Used as text on `body`, `.credential-meta-value`, `.filter-select`. 14.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: gold-badge
tokens.usage: Premium certifications, advanced credentials. Used as text on `.credential-badge.premium`. 2.8:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: amber-pending
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.credential-badge.pending`. 2.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, subtle emphasis. Used as text on `.header-subtitle`, `.section-subtitle`, `.credential-meta`. 7.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-800
tokens.usage: Primary text, maximum hierarchy, Swiss precision.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

styles.usage: Body copy — as `p.section-subtitle` on the reference page.
